title: サクラ大戦3 ～巴里は燃えているか～
title_romaji: Sakura Taisen 3: Paris wa Moeteiru ka

versions.note: disc 1 of 3, version V1.003 (the build HDR-0152-D1-V1.003)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's first disc on flycast (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. Snaps were studied outside it
Characters are Shift-JIS as the game keeps them, but for two codes its font draws otherwise (0x81B8 as "!!", 0x81AC as "!?"), read off the pictures where they stood
The page and the place its typing has got to were found in snaps taken through one page's typing, then followed frame by frame with a probe script over eight pages

Played from the opening's end through the narration over the city, the embassy, the runaway car at the exposition and the talk after it: the route replayed from a state in one run with the script loaded
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 60 of 60 pictures, over 4 scenes; it said nothing on the 2 screens without text
The rows were the script's pages, each held against its picture. A third screen chosen as one without text showed a choice's answers, which the script doesn't read, and was left out
67 harness calls in all, a run's second play among them after the glyphs were found
notes: Read by the script games/dc/HDR-0152-D1.lua: the message window's page once it has typed out (or a press has shown it whole). The DC's A button is the pad's b on flycast; with no memory card the game asks whether to go on without its system file. Not read: who speaks (a face, not a name), a choice's answers, the menus, the screens before the story, and discs 2 and 3.
